items.title: 2.6.3.3 Indexing and Slicing with Negative Indices (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of negative indices (PDF 53-54).

blocks.text: Manfi index sequence ke aakhir se ginte hain: -1 aakhri cheez, -2 aakhri se pehli, waghaira.

blocks.title: Python code (har .... ek 4-space indent hai)
blocks.text:
fruits = ["Apple", "Banana", "Cherry", "Date", "Elderberry"]
print("First fruit:", fruits[0])
print("Last fruit:", fruits[-1])
print(fruits[1:4])    # Banana, Cherry, Date
print(fruits[-4:-1])  # Banana, Cherry, Date

blocks.alt: Oopar: paanch phal dabbon mein, oopar index 0 se 4 aur neeche -5 se -1, aur index 1 se 4 tak slice ka nishan. Neeche baen: main.py greetings.py ko import karta hua aur teen modules wala ecommerce package. Neeche daen: attributes aur method wala ToyCar class ka dabba aur us se bane do car objects, OOP ke khayalat ke notes ke saath.
blocks.caption: Lists, tuples, indexing aur slicing, modules aur object-oriented programming (topics 2.5 se 2.8 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: List ki har cheez ki jagah aage se 0 aur peeche se -1 se gini jati hai, to fruits[0] pehli aur fruits[-1] aakhri cheez hai; fruits[1:4] jaisa slice index 1 se 4 tak magar 4 ke baghair cheezein leta hai. Module code ki file hai jise doosri file import karti hai, aur package mutalliqa modules ka folder hai. Class ek saancha hai, jaise ToyCar jis ke color, size aur wheels aur describe method hain, aur objects is se bani alag alag cars hain jin ki apni qeematein hain.
